introduction: Ohio HWAP provides home energy improvements to eligible households at no cost. A home inspection determines suitable work.
description: Ohio HWAP provides home energy improvements to eligible households at no cost. A home inspection determines suitable work.

sections.who: The current income standard is 200% of federal guidelines. Certain recent HEAP, PIPP Plus, SSI or TANF recipients receive automatic eligibility under the program’s rules.
sections.get: Services may include insulation, air sealing, heating-system work and safety testing. This is home improvement assistance rather than a cash grant.

sections.apply:
1. Request assessment

    Use Ohio Energy Assistance or contact the local energy assistance/community action provider.

  2. Arrange access

    Discuss ownership or landlord permission and schedule the inspection.

  3. Confirm the work

    Ask which measures are approved and when the provider expects to perform them.
sections.after: Priority and scheduling affect when work happens. Discuss any home safety issue before workers visit.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using OCC HWAP. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
